threads.summary: This issue asks TF2 to settle how billing accounts, contracts and contract commitments relate in the SKU Price dataset, a gap raised during the 18 November discussion of #2807. threads.summary: The request asks Unit Format to accept magnitude abbreviations, so a per-million token price reads as 1M Tokens rather than 1000000 Tokens. The aim is that practitioners can spot a unit's scale at a glance and generators can carry AWS and Microsoft style units into FOCUS data unchanged. Task Force 1 agreed the principle in September 2026. threads.summary: jerrysr99 has opened this draft implementing the SKU Price part of FR #2521, which asks for long-context AI charges to be distinguished from standard-context charges for the same model. Google's Gemini models price at a 200K-token prompt threshold, and FOCUS data currently blends those rates together. The pull request adds two Conditional columns, ContextWindowMinimum (exclusive) and ContextWindowMaximum (inclusive), measured in input tokens per request, along with an IncludesContextWindowPricing condition, dataset requirements and an appendix example. Unlike Quantity Tier Minimum, the minimum is null when price does not vary by window size. It is stacked on #2871 and needs that branch first. Trial merges conflict with #2748, #2749 and #2753, which also edit the SKU Price column table. No reviews or approvals exist yet; the only other activity is jerrysr99's comment listing providers with context-window pricing.
